description: Structured planning for multi-item task lists. Produces a tiered, actionable plan that separates what the agent can do now from what needs operator action, identifies blockers, and recommends execution order. Supports three modes: smart (default, tiered by actionability), lazy (minimal, YAGNI-filtered, top 1-2 actions only), thorough (deep investigation, dependency graph, risk analysis, alternatives per item). Use when the user says "plan", "plan in smart mode", "plan in lazy mode", "plan in thorough mode", "how should we approach", or wants to compare planning approaches. Do NOT use for single-step tasks or when the user wants immediate execution without planning.
